gbm_population_evidence.quote: Biopsy proven high-grade glioma (HGG) as defined by 2016 World Health Organization (WHO) Classification Criteria, Grade 3-4 including:

candidate_evidence.quote: The purpose of this study is to measure the benefit of adding abemaciclib to the chemotherapy, temozolomide, for newly diagnosed high-grade glioma following radiotherapy.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A Randomized, Open-Label, Phase 2 Study Evaluating Abemaciclib in Combination With Temozolomide Compared to Temozolomide Monotherapy in Children and Young Adults With Newly Diagnosed High-Grade Glioma Following Radiotherapy

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Pharmacokinetic (PK): Abemaciclib Plasma Concentration: PK Abemaciclib Plasma Concentrations

role_evidence.quote: Participants will receive abemaciclib administered orally in addition to temozolomide administered orally or intravenously (IV).

agents.drug_class_hint: CDK4/6 inhibitor approved for breast cancer

role_evidence.quote: Participants will receive temozolomide administered orally or IV.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: absence of actionable ALK, BRAF or NTRK somatic mutations (exclusion)

source_quote.quote: Have known pathogenic somatic mutations appropriate for an anaplastic lymphoma kinase (ALK), B-rapidly accelerated fibrosarcoma (BRAF), or neurotrophic tyrosine receptor kinase (NTRK ) inhibitor

coder_notes: Paediatric/young-adult mixed HGG trial (ages CHILD and ADULT); glioblastoma explicitly named in inclusion criteria. Record cites both WHO 2016 and WHO 2021 classifications, coded cns5 per the both-met rule. Temozolomide is in both arms (soc_backbone); abemaciclib is the only investigational agent. CDKN2A/B homozygous deletion appears only as a defining feature of some eligible IDH-mutant entities (alternative diagnoses), not as an entry requirement for all patients or for an arm; not coded as an eligibility/enrichment biomarker, although it is mechanistically related to the CDK4/6 inhibitor. Exclusion of tumours with actionable ALK/BRAF/NTRK mutations coded as one 'other' eligibility row (not candidate-matched). PK is plasma only, so tumour_pk_planned no. Registered comparator arm is ACTIVE_COMPARATOR; no OTHER/EXPERIMENTAL arm acts as control.
